protocol.inputs: Every parent input/target/label array copied unchanged; full truth exists only in label arrays
protocol.labels: Normalized raw eligible public TRAIN v/q, q per network lane; non-target evaluator anchors include released-input buffer blanks
protocol.pair_coverage: Eligible adjacent <=5.1min endpoints, observable internal topology, Mode A public on/off ramp validity at interval start

source_snapshot.scope: Own source, vendored official Python and dependency locks; no data, credentials or model weights

source.peak_scope: current process lifetime, not isolated per model
source.source_fingerprint_scope: On-disk source at evidence() call; a captured start archive is primary when present

limitations: Training/scoring label cache only, not a trained model or measured gain. New full labels must not enter inference channels; raw train unavailable outside train split. Mode A public coverage still does not expose actual organizer flux.
